public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most AI demand is driven by hype; once the bubble bursts, demand will depend only on utility and little post-bubble AI economy may exist.

statement.excerpt: With most of the demand for AI driven by endless media and peer pressure, once the AI bubble bursts, the “demand” for AI services will be entirely driven by utility…and considering most services lose money even during the hype cycle, it’s hard to see what post-bubble economy even exists.
